toolbox.name: Microsoft Fabric CAT and repository contributors
toolbox.note: Repository attribution, not a claim that every file has the same individual author.

author-authorized-no-public-license.basis: The user authorized use in this manuscript. No explicit public license was found. No automatic downstream license, copyright transfer, or permission for unrelated reuse is asserted.

lab-apache.note: The license contains the standard unfilled appendix example. It is preserved unchanged, not converted into an invented copyright notice. No NOTICE file was found in the pinned tree.

conventions.dates: UTC calendar dates. created and metadata_updated are GitHub metadata; last_meaningful_change is a content-bearing revision identified by static research. Nonzero line changes alone are not a guarantee of semantic improvement. Null means not established, not absent.
conventions.revision: Full gist revision or Git commit. Gist revisions are not interchangeable with raw-file hashes.
conventions.proposed_chapters: Suggested thematic mapping only; actual_files and integrations record final observed manuscript use.
conventions.actual_files: Book-root-relative links to actual source citations, discussions, or explicitly labeled adaptations. Repository-level discussion requires manual confirmation of the particular pattern; a generic collection link does not adopt every file.
conventions.integration_retained_research: retained-research means retained research/caution source, not individually cited in a chapter/standalone script or used in a worked example. Appendix references remain research citations. An empty actual_files array is a final negative match, not pending reconciliation.
conventions.integration_confirmed: adapted-in-chapter means the stated listing was located in the manuscript and its source attribution checked. It is not tenant execution or proof that all recommended source repairs were validated.
conventions.integration_reference_only: referenced-in-chapter records a verified source citation or discussion, not copied or adapted source code.
conventions.operation_class: Effects of the source as published, not a promise that a future adaptation has the same effects. read-only calls can consume capacity and expose sensitive query text.
conventions.dependencies: Capabilities inferred from operations unless explicitly documented; validate current least-privilege roles and API scopes.
conventions.coherent_repositories: For a multi-file tool use a complete coherent checkout, not a mixture of independently pinned files.
